findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "p_datacrazy" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: datacrazy_conversations_messages_list · Private data: connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: datacrazy_activities_create, datacrazy_business_loss_reasons_create, datacrazy_businesses_actions_lose_create, datacrazy_businesses_actions_move_create, datacrazy_businesses_actions_restore_create, datacrazy_businesses_actions_win_create, datacrazy_businesses_create, datacrazy_conversations_finish_create, datacrazy_conversations_messages_create, datacrazy_leads_additional_fields_create, datacrazy_leads_attachments_create, datacrazy_leads_create, datacrazy_leads_notes_create, datacrazy_lists_create, datacrazy_products_create, datacrazy_tags_create, report_bug · Destructive: datacrazy_activities_delete, datacrazy_business_loss_reasons_delete, datacrazy_businesses_delete, datacrazy_leads_attachments_delete, datacrazy_leads_delete, datacrazy_leads_notes_delete, datacrazy_lists_delete, datacrazy_products_delete, datacrazy_tags_delete, marketplace.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: datacrazy_conversations_messages_list · Private data: connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: datacrazy_activities_create, datacrazy_business_loss_reasons_create, datacrazy_businesses_actions_lose_create, datacrazy_businesses_actions_move_create, datacrazy_businesses_actions_restore_create, datacrazy_businesses_actions_win_create, datacrazy_businesses_create, datacrazy_conversations_finish_create, datacrazy_conversations_messages_create, datacrazy_leads_additional_fields_create, datacrazy_leads_attachments_create, datacrazy_leads_create, datacrazy_leads_notes_create, datacrazy_lists_create, datacrazy_products_create, datacrazy_tags_create, report_bug · Destructive: datacrazy_activities_delete, datacrazy_business_loss_reasons_delete, datacrazy_businesses_delete, datacrazy_leads_attachments_delete, datacrazy_leads_delete, datacrazy_leads_notes_delete, datacrazy_lists_delete, datacrazy_products_delete, datacrazy_tags_delete, marketplace

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
